commit_message: Add ADR0156 benchmark execution identity schema
pr_body:
## Summary

Starts the current-main ADR 0156 implementation on top of merged ADR 0155. Extends ADR 0142 records additively with optional campaign execution identity while retaining schema-v1 read compatibility. Existing manual benchmark records continue to write no campaign identity.

Further campaign orchestration, managed acquisition, worker execution, and UI changes continue on this Draft PR.
